item.title: Fred Rogers Productions Launches Many Ways to Show You Care - Fred Rogers Productions
item.description: Many Ways to Show You Care, a joy-filled multiplatform content initiative from Fred Rogers Productions, will launch on November 7. Content will be available on pbskids.org, the PBS KIDS Video app, and the PBS KIDS for Parents YouTube channel. The initiative includes documentary shorts, a Fred Rogers-inspired music video, educator lesson plans, and family activities.
